description: Python's AMP runtime and firmware dependency snapshot checks on named trees. Each case writes its tree (text, hexadecimal bytes, symlinks or empty folders, {root} replaced by the case directory), calls function runtime (validate_runtime_snapshot on <case>/capture), image (validate_image_dependency_snapshot on <case>/image) or record_count (image_dependency_record_count) with argument ({root} replaced), and gives value, refusal or os_error, the case directory written <root>.
